entries.title: Observer

emulation.notes: Use the native System Redux PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with scalable settings, ray-tracing-capable hardware support, and capture flexibility.

primary.why: Observer: System Redux is the best route for the original Observer because it is the upgraded and expanded version with redesigned visuals, rebuilt mechanics, and additional story content, while the PC release gives the highest-fidelity capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Observer: System Redux on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Use the 2017 original only for historical comparison.
